subtopic: Mean and Variance of a Binomial Distribution
Mean and Variance of a Binomial Distribution
stem: Let the p.m.f. of r.v. \(X\) be \(P(X = x) = {}^{4}C_{x}\left(\dfrac{5}{9}\right)^{x} \times \left(\dfrac{4}{9}\right)^{4-x}\), for \(x = 0, 1, 2, 3, 4\). Then find \(E(X)\) and \(\text{Var}(X)\).
solution:
\(P(X = x)\) is binomial distribution with \(n = 4\), \(p = \dfrac{5}{9}\) and \(q = \dfrac{4}{9}\)
\(E(X) = np\)
\(= 4 \times \left(\dfrac{5}{9}\right) = \dfrac{20}{9}\)
\(\text{Var}(X) = npq\)
\(= 4 \times \left(\dfrac{5}{9}\right) \times \left(\dfrac{4}{9}\right) = \dfrac{80}{81}\)

subtopic: Mean and Variance of a Binomial Distribution
solution:
\(E(X) = 6\) therefore \(np = 6\) and \(\text{Var}(X) = 4.2\) therefore \(npq = 4.2\)
\(\dfrac{npq}{np} = \dfrac{4.2}{6}\)
\(\therefore q = 0.7\)
\(\therefore p = 1 - q = 1 - 0.7\)
\(\therefore p = 0.3\)
\(np = 6\)
\(\therefore n \times 0.3 = 6\)
\(\therefore n = \dfrac{6}{0.3} = 20\)
